mn53:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
mn53:2.1: tena kho pana samayena kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
mn53:2.2: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn53:2.3: idha bhante, kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
mn53:2.4: taṃ bhante bhagavā paṭhamaṃ paribhuñjatu. bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā kāpilavatthavā sakyā paribhuñjissanti.
mn53:2.5: tadassa kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyā’ti.
mn53:3.2: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santhāgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
mn53:3.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn53:3.5: sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ bhante santhāgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telappadīpo āropito.
mn53:4.1: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimaṃ thambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
mn53:4.2: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi, bhagavantaṃ yeva purakkhatvā.
mn53:4.3: kāpilavatthavāpi kho sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchāmukhā nisīdiṃsu, bhagavantaṃyeva purakkhatvā.
mn53:5.1: atha kho bhagavā kāpilavatthave sakye bahudevarattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn53:5.2: paṭibhātu taṃ ānanda kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekho pāṭipado
mn53:5.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn53:5.6: atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
mn53:6.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando mahānāmaṃ sakyaṃ āmantesi.
mn53:6.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti. indriyesu guttadvāro hoti. bhojane mattaññū hoti. jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti. sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti. catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn53:7.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlavā hoti. pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno, aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
mn53:7.3: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti.
mn53:8.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti:
mn53:8.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn53:8.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ. tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati cakkhundriyaṃ, cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn53:8.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na nimittaggāhī hoti nānubyañjanaggāhī.
mn53:8.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ. tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjati, rakkhati manindriyaṃ, manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
mn53:8.10: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti.
mn53:9.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti:
mn53:9.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako paṭisaṅkhā yoniso āhāraṃ āhāreti,
mn53:9.3: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya, yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya, vihiṃsūparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya. iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi. navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi. yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cā ti.
mn53:9.4: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti.
mn53:10.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti:
mn53:10.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn53:10.3: rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn53:10.4: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeti, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, sato sampajāno, uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā.
mn53:10.5: rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn53:10.6: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti.
mn53:11.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti:
mn53:11.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako saddho hoti. saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ.
mn53:11.3: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
mn53:12.1: hirimā hoti. hirīyati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena. hirīyati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
mn53:13.1: ottappī hoti, ottappati kāyaduccaritena vacīduccaritena manoduccaritena. ottappati pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ samāpattiyā.
mn53:14.1: bahussuto hoti sutadharo sutasannicayo. ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti. tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
mn53:15.1: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
mn53:16.1: satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato. cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā
mn53:17.1: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
mn53:17.2: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti.
mn53:18.1: kathañca mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
mn53:18.2: idha mahānāma ariyasāvako vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn53:18.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ
mn53:18.6: evaṃ kho mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn53:19.1: yato kho mahānāma ariyasāvako evaṃ sīlasampanno hoti. evaṃ indriyesu guttadvāro hoti. evaṃ bhojane mattaññū hoti. evaṃ jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti. evaṃ sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti. evaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī, akasiralābhī. ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako sekho pāṭipado apuccaṇḍatāya samāpanno bhabbo abhinibbhidāya bhabbo sambodhāya bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
mn53:19.2: seyyathāpi mahānāma kukkuṭiyā aṇḍāni aṭṭha vā dasa vā dvādasa vā, tānāssu kukkuṭiyā sammā adhisayitāni sammā pariseditāni sammā paribhāvitāni, kiñcāpi tassā kukkuṭiyā na evaṃ icchā uppajjeyya:
mn53:19.3: aho vatime kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyyu’nti.
mn53:19.4: atha kho bhabbāva te kukkuṭapotakā pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjituṃ.
mn53:19.5: evameva kho mahānāma yato ariyasāvako evaṃ sīlasampanno hoti, evaṃ indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, evaṃ bhojane mattaññū hoti, evaṃ jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti, evaṃ sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, evaṃ catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako sekho pāṭipado apuccaṇḍatāya samāpanno bhabbo abhinibbhidāya bhabbo sambodhāya bhabbo anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
mn53:20.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn53:20.2: seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn53:21.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn53:22.1: sa kho so mahānāma ariyasāvako imaṃyeva anuttaraṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ āgamma āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn53:23.1: yampi kho mahānāma ariyasāvako sīlasampanno hoti, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:23.2: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako indriyesu guttadvāro hoti, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:23.3: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako bhojane mattaññū hoti, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:23.4: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:23.5: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:23.6: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, idampissa hoti caraṇasmiṃ.
mn53:24.1: yampi kho mahānāma ariyasāvako anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati. seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati, idampissa hoti vijjāya.
mn53:24.2: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne upapajjamāne, hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate - yathākammūpage satte pajānāti, idampissa hoti vijjāya.
mn53:24.3: yampi mahānāma ariyasāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, idampissa hoti vijjāya.
mn53:25.1: ayaṃ vuccati mahānāma ariyasāvako vijjāsampanno itipi, caraṇasampanno itipi. vijjācaraṇasampanno itipi.
mn53:25.2: brahmunā kho panesā mahānāma sanaṅkumārena gāthā bhāsitā.
mn53:25.7: sā kho panesā mahānāma brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatāti.
mn53:26.1: atha kho bhagavā uṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi:
mn53:26.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ ānanda kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ sekhaṃ pāṭipadaṃ abhāsīti.
mn53:26.6: attamanā kāpilavatthavā sakyā āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
